tools.name: analytics_new_contact_counts_per_day
tools.description:
Get new contact counts per day

Charts newly created contacts per day in the range. When `to` is more than 60 full days after `from`, the series uses monthly buckets (first day of the month) instead of daily ones. Compare it with `analytics.blockedContactsPerDay` to separate acquisition trends from blocked contacts.

annotations.title: Get new contact counts per day

channels.description: Only include these channels. Omit or leave empty for all. Older bot-message and conversation events carry no channel and are only counted when this is omitted.

inboxIds.description: Only include these inboxes. Omit or leave empty for all. Events recorded before inbox tracking existed carry no inbox and are only counted when this is omitted.

tools.name: broadcasts_list
tools.description:
List broadcasts

Use this to find broadcasts before inspecting one with `broadcasts.get` or stopping one with `broadcasts.stop`. Filter by `status`, `name`, `channel` or a `scheduledFrom`/`scheduledTo` window; newest first unless `sort` is given. Each broadcast includes its channel, subaction, template, audience filter and per-page targets.

perPage.description: Number of items per page, up to 50.

status.description: Restrict to broadcasts in this status.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the broadcast name.

channel.description: Restrict to broadcasts sent on this channel.

scheduledFrom.description: Only broadcasts scheduled at or after this time (ISO 8601).

scheduledTo.description: Only broadcasts scheduled at or before this time (ISO 8601).

sort.description: Sort order as [{ id, desc }] pairs, e.g. `createdAt`, `schedulesAt`, `name`. Defaults to newest first.

schedulesType.description: Restrict to one schedule type. `recurring` lists the repeating broadcasts themselves.

parentBroadcastId.description: Only the runs of this repeating broadcast. Get its id from `broadcasts.list` with `schedulesType: recurring`; combine with `scheduledFrom`/`scheduledTo` for one period.

includeRuns.description: `false` hides the runs of repeating broadcasts, leaving one-offs and the repeating broadcasts. Defaults to `true`.

excludeTemplates.description: `true` hides the repeating broadcasts themselves (they never send on their own), leaving one-offs and runs. Defaults to `false`.

statusReason.description: Set when the system (not a person) stopped the broadcast: `accountPolicyBlocked` or `accountSendRestricted` — the channel page is blocked from sending, so every recipient would fail. Cleared on resume. Check the page is unblocked before resuming: if it is not, the first message fails and the broadcast stops again.

statusInboxId.description: The inbox (channel page) whose send error caused `statusReason`.

parentBroadcastId.description: For a run: the id of the repeating broadcast that created it.

occurrenceAt.description: For a run: the scheduled slot it was created for.

monthDay.description: Monthly only. Day 29–31 runs on the last day of shorter months; "last" always means the last day.

excludeDates.description: Local dates (YYYY-MM-DD, in `timezone`) that must not send. The series keeps running and the skipped run is recorded as skipped. At most 366.

nextRunAt.description: The series' next slot; null while the series is paused or over. It may fall on a skipped date — use `nextSendAt` for the next run that will really send.

nextSendAt.description: The next run that will really send, after skipping `rule.excludeDates`; null when paused, over, or only skipped dates remain.

upcomingRuns.description: ISO 8601 times of the next runs (detail only).

recurrence.description: The repeat schedule, present only when `schedulesType` is `recurring`.

parent.description: For a run: the repeating broadcast that created it.

contactFilter.description: The contact filter that defines the audience.

targets.description: Per-page targets of a multi-page broadcast.

tools.description: List active flows in the workspace, newest first unless `sort` is given. Filter by `name` (substring), `folderId`, or `startType`. This profile reads flows only; it cannot create, edit, publish or send them.

perPage.description: Number of items per page, up to 50.

active.description: Restrict to active flows. Set to false to include inactive ones too.

enableInInbox.description: Restrict to flows that can be started from the inbox (`enableInInbox` true). Omit for all flows.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the flow name.

folderId.description: Folder id to filter by. Pass "0" for flows in no folder. Omit for all folders.

startType.description: Only flows whose start node, in the draft or the published version, has a step that sends this kind of template message. `sendWaTemplateMessage` also needs `integrationWhatsappId`, otherwise nothing matches.

integrationWhatsappId.description: With `startType` `sendWaTemplateMessage`: only flows whose template belongs to this WhatsApp channel id.

sort.description: Sort order as [{ id, desc }] pairs on `name`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`. Defaults to newest first.

pageCount.description: Total number of pages for the requested perPage; stop when page >= pageCount.

tools.name: flows_get
tools.description:
Get flow

Use this to inspect one flow and its versions after finding its id with `flows.list`.

id.description: flow id (numeric string). Get it from `flows.list`.

integrationMessengerId.description: Messenger channel id, as used by `messengerChannels.getSettings`.

welcomeMessageFlowId.description: Meta welcome message flow id. Use it as `partner_app_welcome_message_flow_id` in a Click-to-Messenger ad creative, or pick it under Partner app in Ads Manager.

tools.name: keywords_list
tools.description: List keyword automations. Inbound keywords match messages from contacts; outbound keywords match messages sent by the page or agent.

perPage.description: Number of items per page, up to 50.

type.description: Keyword direction: inbound matches messages from contacts; outbound matches messages sent by the Page/agent. Defaults to inbound. Keep the same type when reading, updating, disabling, or deleting a rule. This is not post/comment automation; use the channel's comment-automation tools for comments.

conditions.description: Contact (inbound) match conditions; null on outbound rules. `keywords` lists every condition value.

pageCount.description: Total number of pages for the requested perPage; stop when page >= pageCount.

tools.name: messages_list
tools.description:
List messages on conversation

Lists messages on the given conversation, newest-related pagination via `cursor`. Use `conversations.get` first if you only have a contact identifier.

conversationId.description: Conversation id (numeric string). Get it from `conversations.list`.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Omit for the first page.

displayText.description: Inbound: the text translated into the workspace language. Outbound: the sentence the agent typed (`message.text` is what the customer received). `null` unless `translated`.

tools.name: mini_apps_list
tools.description:
List Mini Apps

Lists the workspace's Mini Apps (WhatsApp Flow forms) with their public link. Returns `{ data, pageCount }`; page with `page`/`perPage`.

perPage.description: Number of items per page, up to 50.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the name.

enabled.description: Disabled Mini Apps cannot be opened from their public link.

submissionsCount.description: Answers received through the public link.

publicUrl.description: Public link that renders the Mini App on the web, for any channel. Send it from a flow as-is: `{{mini_app_token}}` is filled per contact so answers are attributed; opened elsewhere it works anonymously.

pageCount.description: Total number of pages for the requested perPage; stop when page >= pageCount.

tools.name: pipelines_list
tools.description:
List pipelines

Pipelines (CRM kanban boards) with their item counts.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code item values are in: the pipeline's own `currencyOverride`, else the workspace default (the currency of its target country, else USD).

currencyOverride.description: The currency set on this pipeline, or null when it follows the workspace default. Set it with `pipelines.update`; send `currency: null` there to follow the workspace again.

tools.name: pipelines_list_items
tools.description:
List pipeline items

Items of a pipeline, newest first by default. Filter by stage, status, priority, assignee, contact, value, a custom field, search, or date ranges (due, created, updated, last comment, status change, stage entry, won/lost closure). Page with `nextCursor`; keep `sort`, `direction` and the filters unchanged between pages.

stageId.description: Comma-separated stage ids: items in any of them.

contactId.description: Only this contact's items. Get it from `contacts.list`.

assigneeMemberId.description: Comma-separated workspace member ids: items assigned to any of them.

assigneeInboxTeamId.description: Comma-separated inbox team ids: items assigned to any of them.

search.description: Matches the title, item number, or the contact's name/email/phone.

valueOperator.description: How to compare the item value: `eq`, `gt`, `lt` and `ne` use `valueAmount` (`ne` also matches items without a value); `between` uses `valueMin`/`valueMax`. Omit it to filter by `valueMin`/`valueMax` alone.

valueMin.description: Only items worth at least this much.

valueMax.description: Only items worth at most this much.

dueFrom.description: Due at or after this time.

dueTo.description: Due at or before this time.

createdFrom.description: Created at or after this time.

createdTo.description: Created at or before this time.

updatedFrom.description: Only items last updated at or after this ISO date-time. Combine with `updatedTo` for a range.

updatedTo.description: Only items last updated at or before this ISO date-time. Combine with `updatedFrom` for a range.

lastCommentFrom.description: Only items whose latest comment was written at or after this ISO date-time. Combine with `lastCommentTo` for a range.

lastCommentTo.description: Only items whose latest comment was written at or before this ISO date-time. Combine with `lastCommentFrom` for a range.

statusChangedFrom.description: Only items whose status last changed at or after this ISO date-time. Combine with `statusChangedTo` for a range.

statusChangedTo.description: Only items whose status last changed at or before this ISO date-time. Combine with `statusChangedFrom` for a range.

stageEnteredFrom.description: Only items that entered their current stage at or after this ISO date-time. Combine with `stageEnteredTo` for a range.

stageEnteredTo.description: Only items that entered their current stage at or before this ISO date-time. Combine with `stageEnteredFrom` for a range.

wonClosedFrom.description: Only items now `won` whose closure happened at or after this ISO date-time. Combine with `wonClosedTo` for a range.

wonClosedTo.description: Only items now `won` whose closure happened at or before this ISO date-time. Combine with `wonClosedFrom` for a range.

lostClosedFrom.description: Only items now `lost` whose closure happened at or after this ISO date-time. Combine with `lostClosedTo` for a range.

lostClosedTo.description: Only items now `lost` whose closure happened at or before this ISO date-time. Combine with `lostClosedFrom` for a range.

activityGroups.description: Comma-separated kinds of change: only items with an activity entry of one of them. `lifecycle` = created/transferred/deleted, `stage`, `status`, `value`, `priority`, `dueDate`, `details` = title/description/custom fields, `assignees`, `comments`, `attachments`. Combined with `activityActor` and `activityFrom`/`activityTo`, one single entry must satisfy all of them. Only activity recorded in this pipeline counts.

activityActor.description: Comma-separated actors: only items with an activity entry done by one of them. Same single-entry rule as `activityGroups`.

activityFrom.description: Only items with an activity entry at or after this ISO date-time. Combine with `activityTo` for a range.

activityTo.description: Only items with an activity entry at or before this ISO date-time. Combine with `activityFrom` for a range.

fieldId.description: Custom field id to filter on; pair it with `fieldOperator` and its operands (`fieldValue`, `fieldValueTo`).

fieldOperator.description: How custom field `fieldId` is compared. Allowed per field type — text, long text, email, phone: `is`, `isNot`, `hasValue`, `noValue`, `contains`, `notContains`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`; number, date, datetime: `is`, `isNot`, `hasValue`, `noValue`, `gt`, `lt`, `between`; boolean: `is`, `isNot`, `hasValue`, `noValue`. `hasValue`/`noValue` take no operand. `isNot` and `notContains` only match items that have a value. A date compares its stored day as written; a datetime compares its calendar day in `timezone`. An operator the field's type does not offer is rejected with 422.

fieldValue.description: Operand of `fieldOperator`: text for text fields, a number such as `42.5` for number fields, a day `YYYY-MM-DD` for date and datetime fields, `true` or `false` for boolean fields. For `between` it is the lower bound (omit for an open lower bound).

fieldValueTo.description: Upper bound of `fieldOperator` `between` (same format as `fieldValue`, inclusive; omit for an open upper bound).

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`) whose calendar days datetime custom-field conditions compare in (date fields ignore it). Defaults to the workspace timezone.

sort.description: Sort key. Items without a value for it come last.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` of the previous page. Keep sort and filters unchanged.

value.description: Amount in the pipeline currency.

fieldValues.description: Custom field values keyed by pipeline field id.

tools.name: sequences_list
tools.description: Returns sequences available in the workspace; filter by `name`, `folderId` or `active`, sort with `sort`.

perPage.description: Number of items per page, up to 50.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the sequence name.

folderId.description: Only sequences in this folder; "0" for sequences in no folder.

sort.description: Sort order as [{ id, desc }] pairs, e.g. `createdAt`, `name`. Defaults to newest first.

tools.description:
Get sequence

tools.name: contacts_create
tools.description:
Create contact

Adds a contact to the inbox given by `inboxId` and opens its conversation, so `contacts.sendMessage` works right after. Use `contacts.list` to check for an existing contact first.

phoneNumber.description: Contact's phone number (on WhatsApp this is the WhatsApp ID / `wa_id`). When `channel` is `whatsapp`, provide this, `sourceUserId`, or both.

sourceUserId.description: WhatsApp Business-Scoped User ID (BSUID, e.g. `US.13491208655302741918`), for users who hide their phone number. Only for `channel` `whatsapp`; provide this, `phoneNumber`, or both. Without a phone number the contact is keyed and messaged by this BSUID.

email.description: Contact's email address. Required when `channel` is `smtp`.

contactId.description: Channel-specific user id (e.g. Messenger PSID). Required for channels other than webchat/omnichannel.

channel.description: Channel this contact is reachable on; determines which of phoneNumber/email/contactId is required.

inboxId.description: Inbox id (numeric string) to create the contact in.

_confirm.description: Set to true only after the user has reviewed the proposed action and explicitly confirmed it.

contactCustomFields.description: Stored values keyed by `customFieldId`, without field names or types. Use `contacts.listCustomFields` for each value with its field's name and type.

tools.name: contacts_add_tags_by_name
tools.description: Add tags to a contact by tag name. Existing tags with a matching name are reused; unmatched names are created. Example: `{"tags":["VIP"]}`.

annotations.title: Add tags to contact by name

identifier.description: Contact identifier with a required prefix: id:123, email:ada@example.com, or phone:+841234567890. Bare ids, emails, phone numbers, and display names are invalid. For a name, search contacts.list and use id:<returned id>.

tags.description: Tag names — not ids. Existing tags whose name matches are reused; unmatched names are created as new tags.

_confirm.description: Set to true only after the user has reviewed the proposed action and explicitly confirmed it.

tools.name: contacts_set_custom_field
tools.description:
Set contact custom field value

Changes one custom-field value on a resolved contact without altering its other fields.

identifier.description: Contact identifier with a required prefix: id:123, email:ada@example.com, or phone:+841234567890. Bare ids, emails, phone numbers, and display names are invalid. For a name, search contacts.list and use id:<returned id>.

idOrName.description: Custom field id (numeric string) or field name.

value.description: New value for the custom field.

clientTimezone.description: IANA timezone of the caller, e.g. `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`. Anchors a date-only value to that calendar day; defaults to the contact's, then the workspace's zone.

_confirm.description: Set to true only after the user has reviewed the proposed action and explicitly confirmed it.

tools.name: contacts_send_message
tools.description: Send one message to a contact on a chosen inbox. This delivers the message to a real person on a real channel and cannot be undone. Show the user the exact text and recipient before confirming. Delivery is asynchronous: a message the channel rejects is removed from the conversation.

identifier.description: Contact identifier with a required prefix: id:123, email:ada@example.com, or phone:+841234567890. Bare ids, emails, phone numbers, and display names are invalid. For a name, search contacts.list and use id:<returned id>.

display.description: "products": one product, or a list of products grouped in sections. "carousel": 2+ products as scrollable cards.

header.description: Header text. Only for the "products" display with 2+ products.

body.description: Message text. Required for most displays, see the channel capabilities.

title.description: Section title. Required by some channels once there are 2+ sections.

sections.description: Product sections. "products": 1+ sections; "carousel": exactly one untitled section.

products.description: Catalog products to send instead of text, on channels with product messages (WhatsApp today) inside the customer-service window. Cannot be combined with text, files, media, `flowId` or a comment reply: when `products` is valid only it is sent.

files.description: Media files to attach, up to 5MB each.

path.description: The file is looked up by this value.

url.description: Optional public URL, display only; the server resolves the real URL from `path`.

mediaFile.description: Media library file reference to attach.

mediaFileId.description: Media library file id (numeric string) to attach.

mediaFileIds.description: Media library file ids (numeric strings) to attach, up to 10.

flowId.description: Flow id (numeric string) to send instead of a plain message. Get it from `flows.list`.

nodeId.description: Node id within the flow to start from. Defaults to the flow's start node.

inboxId.description: Optional numeric channel inbox ID. Omit this field to use the existing inbox resolution fallback.

clientId.description: Client-generated id echoed back for de-duplication.

replyToMessageId.description: Id of the message this one replies to.

replyToMessageCreatedAt.description: Creation timestamp of the message this one replies to.

isPrivateReply.description: When true, sends as a comment-anchored private reply DM instead of a public comment reply.

translate.description: Inbox translation: translate `text` into the customer's language before sending. Only for a plain text message (no files, media, products, flow, reply or private reply). Waits at most 10 s for the translation. If translation is off for the conversation or the language is unknown, the text is sent as written and the response says why in `translationFallback`.

targetLanguage.description: Language code: ISO 639-1 such as `es`, or `zh-Hans` / `zh-Hant` for Chinese.

editedTranslation.description: Used only when `targetLanguage` still matches the conversation's language; otherwise it is discarded, the text is translated again, and the response sets `editedTranslationDiscarded`. Requires `translate: true`.

_confirm.description: Set to true only after the user has reviewed the proposed action and explicitly confirmed it.

tools.name: conversations_assign
tools.description:
Assign or unassign conversation to user or inbox team

Changes a conversation's user or inbox-team assignee, or clears it when `assignedId` is null. Call `conversations.get` first to inspect the current assignee and `conversations.list` to find the id.

annotations.title: Assign or unassign conversation to user or inbox team

assignedId.description: New assignee: `u_<userId>` for a user or `t_<inboxTeamId>` for an inbox team, or null to unassign.

_confirm.description: Set to true only after the user has reviewed the proposed action and explicitly confirmed it.

tools.name: broadcasts_stop
tools.description:
Stop broadcast

Stops a broadcast while it is sending and returns its id. On a repeating broadcast (status `recurring`) it pauses the schedule: no new runs start, a run already sending carries on. Allowed even when the workspace trial has expired, like the builder. The system also stops a broadcast on its own when the channel page is blocked from sending: the broadcast then has a `statusReason` (and `statusErrorMessage`, `statusInboxId`) in `broadcasts.get`.

_confirm.description: Set to true only after the user has reviewed the proposed action and explicitly confirmed it.

tools.name: pipelines_create_item
tools.description:
Create pipeline item

Adds an item for a contact (get `contactId` from `contacts.list`). Without `stageId` it lands in the first stage. Pass `idempotencyKey` so a retried request does not create a second item. A pipeline may limit open items per contact (409).

contactId.description: Contact the item belongs to. Get it from `contacts.list`.

description.description: Plain-text description, up to 5000 characters. Null clears it.

value.description: Amount in the pipeline currency. Null clears it.

status.description: `open`, `won` or `lost`. Won/lost closes the item; `open` reopens it.

dueDate.description: Due date and time (ISO 8601). Null clears it.

fieldValuesTimezone.description: Valid IANA timezone (e.g. `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`) that anchors `date` custom-field values sent in `fieldValues`; an unknown zone is rejected with 422. Defaults to the contact's, then the workspace's, timezone.

idempotencyKey.description: Repeating a request with the same key returns the first item instead of creating another. Reusing a key for a different contact is a 409.

_confirm.description: Set to true only after the user has reviewed the proposed action and explicitly confirmed it.

value.description: Amount in the pipeline currency.

fieldValues.description: Custom field values keyed by pipeline field id.

tools.name: pipelines_move_item
tools.description:
Move item to stage

Moves the item to another stage of the same pipeline.

_confirm.description: Set to true only after the user has reviewed the proposed action and explicitly confirmed it.

value.description: Amount in the pipeline currency.
